meta.title: WayMeld — Collect places. Meld your route.
meta.description: Search, pin places, and build a timed itinerary. Kakao & Google Maps, multi-day trips, shareable links.

notice.trial: Trial operation through August. Official launch in September.

hero.title:
Collect places.
Meld your route.
hero.subtitle: Search and pin spots—they group by category. Drag to reorder, then build a timed itinerary. Not a visited map—a tool for weaving your next route.
hero.note: Web app · works offline locally without sign-in

search.title: Search & collect
search.body: Find places by keyword or category and pin from search or the map. Food, cafés, and sights appear as chips.

route.title: Meld your route
route.body: Timed schedule with stay durations and lunch-aware slots. Real road distances via Kakao mobility when available.

share.title: Share & remix
share.body: Send a read-only link to friends or import public trips from the share plaza into your plan.

features.title: Built for routing
features.subtitle: Unlike apps that track where you’ve been, WayMeld is for where you’re going next—and when.

multiDay.title: Multi-day tabs
multiDay.body: Split pins and routes across Day 1, Day 2, Day 3. Long trips stay organized.

category.title: Category pin bar
category.body: Drag chips to reorder or move categories. Filter the map to one category at a time.

maps.title: Kakao + Google
maps.body: Kakao for Korea, Google Places abroad. UI in Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, French, German, and Russian.

presentation.title: Presentation mode
presentation.body: Show your route clearly in meetings, classes, or guided tours.

scenario.title: AI Scenarios
scenario.body: Pick a theme and get a real, place-backed day plan you can drop straight into your trip.

step1.title: Pin it
step1.body: No install — search or tap the map in your browser to add places.

step2.title: Build the schedule
step2.body: Drag to reorder, then turn it into a timed, hour-by-hour route.

step3.title: Share
step3.body: Share a link or publish to the plaza for others.

tips.title: Travel tips
tips.subtitle: Practical guides for transit, payments, and connectivity in Korea

cta.title: Plan your next route today
cta.subtitle: Save locally without signing in. Cloud sync and multilingual export on Plus.
